cases.code:
import ast
src = open(sol.__file__).read()
tree = ast.parse(src)
imports = any(isinstance(n, (ast.Import, ast.ImportFrom)) for n in ast.walk(tree))
attrs = set()
calls = set()
for n in ast.walk(tree):
    if isinstance(n, ast.Attribute) and n.attr in ('format', 'format_map'):
        attrs.add(n.attr)
    if isinstance(n, ast.Name) and n.id in ('format', 'eval', 'exec'):
        calls.add(n.id)
result = (imports, sorted(attrs), sorted(calls))
